reason: A DSH web interface plugin that displays a draggable pixel-art whale overlay reacting to Harness session states and user interactions.

summaries.zh: 在 dsh web 右下角显示可拖动的像素化 DeepSeek 鲸鱼，并根据 Harness 会话状态进行动画反馈。
summaries.en: Displays a draggable pixel-art DeepSeek whale in dsh web that animates in response to Harness session states.

capabilities: Reads DSH session snapshots to select an animated overlay state
Renders a draggable pixel-art whale overlay in the dsh web interface
Handles click, drag, and Alt-click interactions
Stores the whale position in browser localStorage
